title: Turned $50K to $500K Then Lost It All Trading the 112 Options Strategy | Real Trader Story
summary: Murray Lindholt grew a $50K /ES account to ~$526K (2020-2024) trading the 1-1-2 (a put debit spread financed by 2 far-OTM naked puts for net credit), then lost all four years of profit in days when he added size into the August 2024 carry-trade vol spike and got margin-called to ruin at ~200% buying power.
